items.title: Chemours Shares Rise 6% After $455 Million North Carolina PFAS Settlement
items.summary: Chemours (NYSE:CC) shares rose 6% on Thursday after the company announced a settlement with the State of North Carolina and 11 local entities covering PFAS-related claims. The agreement resolves litigation concerning PFAS and other historical discharges from the Fayetteville Works facility, as well as claims involving alleged PFAS contamination unrelated to the site, including the use of aqueous film forming foam.
